ev.q: roofs covered with grass and turf were common on houses in Scandinavia for centuries

1.why: A段。a traditional use of plants on roofs ↔ roofs covered with grass and turf were common on houses in Scandinavia for centuries。B段讲的是德国20世纪70–80年代的新技术，不是传统做法。

ev.q: although the proportion is much lower during long periods of heavy rain, when the soil becomes saturated

2.why: C段。a benefit is smaller in certain weather conditions ↔ the proportion is much lower during long periods of heavy rain；reason ↔ when the soil becomes saturated。D段的降温效果在低矮建筑中最好，那是建筑类型的差异，不是天气。

ev.q: In 2009 Toronto became the first city in North America to require them on many new buildings above a certain size.

3.why: F段。a rule requiring green roofs ↔ Some cities have made green roofs compulsory … Toronto … to require them。B段德国城市提供的是资金支持（financial support），不是强制要求。

ev.q: the thin, uniform planting used on most commercial roofs supports far fewer species than a roof designed with deeper soil

4.why: E段 Reid。the design of a roof affects how many species it supports ↔ thin, uniform planting … supports far fewer species than a roof designed with deeper soil, a mixture of plants…。

ev.q: by placing solar panels above planted roofs

5.why: G段。two technologies being combined ↔ designers are combining approaches … placing solar panels above planted roofs。

ev.q: the savings are greatest in low buildings, where the roof makes up a larger share of the building's outer surface

6.why: D段末句。the type of building that gains most ↔ the savings are greatest in low buildings。F段要求的是 new buildings above a certain size，与降温无关。

ev.q: These 'extensive' green roofs need little care and can be added to many existing buildings

7.why: B段。B can be added to many buildings that already exist ↔ can be added to many existing buildings。A 是最大陷阱：需要较厚土层、定期浇水的是同段后面提到的 intensive 屋顶，而 extensive 屋顶 only a few centimetres deep、need little care；D 混淆了A段斯堪的纳维亚的传统草皮屋顶；C 文中未提。

ev.q: although the proportion is much lower during long periods of heavy rain, when the soil becomes saturated

8.why: C段。D The effect is weakest during long spells of heavy rain ↔ the proportion is much lower during long periods of heavy rain。A 错：只保留一半到四分之三；B 过度：原文没说能完全防止下水道溢出；C 文中未比较新旧屋顶。

ev.q: partly because water evaporating from them uses up heat

9.why: D段。A Evaporation takes heat away from them ↔ water evaporating from them uses up heat。B 是G段白色屋顶的原理（reflect sunlight），不是植物屋顶。

ev.q: Building owners also worry about leaks, which can be difficult to locate beneath a layer of soil and plants.

10.why: F段末句。C Leaks may be hard to find ↔ worry about leaks, which can be difficult to locate。A 与E段相反（昆虫被视为好处）；B 与G段相反（植物让太阳能板更高效）。

ev.q: A green roof can cost two or three times as much to install as a conventional one

11.why: F段。double or triple ↔ two or three times as much；the ___ kind ↔ a conventional one。不要填 green：比较的对象是普通屋顶。

ev.q: the building must be strong enough to carry the extra weight, especially when the soil is wet

12.why: F段。support additional ↔ carry the extra；above all when the soil is wet ↔ especially when the soil is wet。

ev.q: In hot, sunny regions, roofs painted white to reflect sunlight can cool buildings more cheaply

13.why: G段。in hot, sunny places ↔ In hot, sunny regions；at lower cost ↔ more cheaply；___ roofs ↔ roofs painted white。solar panels 是另一种选择，讲的是能源，不是降温。
